patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Nextiva and Zoom share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Frame: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Nextiva and Zoom share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.. Choose Nextiva only if your buying job matches “SMB-friendly unified business communications — Core $15, Engage $25, Scale $75 per user/mo” rather than Zoom's shape. Choose Zoom only if your buying job matches “Meetings-first Workplace suite plus Zoom Phone UCaaS — Phone US/CA Unlimited research floo” rather than Nextiva's shape. Workflow advantage: Nextiva leans customer-messaging, contact-center; Zoom leans shared coverage. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Nextiva and Zoom share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Nextiva is SMB-friendly unified business communications — Core $15, Engage $25, Scale $75 per user/month annual, with messaging apps including WhatsApp; Zoom is Meetings-first Workplace suite plus Zoom Phone UCaaS — Phone US/CA Unlimited research floor ~$15–16/user/month; free meetings/chat exist but.
- Workflow coverage skew: Nextiva-leaning customer-messaging, contact-center vs Zoom-leaning —.
- Researched limits: Nextiva — Call recording is an add-on on Core rather than included; Zoom — Free Workplace covers meetings/chat — not full Zoom Phone PSTN service.

Limitations — Nextiva: Call recording is an add-on on Core rather than included; Analytics and AI assistance require Scale / higher plans or XBert add-on from $99/mo; Zoom: Free Workplace covers meetings/chat — not full Zoom Phone PSTN service; Phone seat floors and Pro Plus / Business Plus bundles are medium confidence and region-sensitive.

Poor-fit cases: Nextiva is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Call recording is an add-on on Core rather than included · Zoom is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Free Workplace covers meetings/chat — not full Zoom Phone PSTN service · Avoid Nextiva if you actually need Zoom's motion (Meetings-first Workplace suite plus Zoom Phone UCaaS — Phone US/CA Unlimited res)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
